description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a language selection screen in an app, allowing users to choose their preferred language, persisting the choice, and navigating to OTP validation.

classes.name: LanguageScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of languages for user selection and navigates to OTP validation upon confirmation.

classes.name: _LanguageScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the language selection logic, UI rendering, and persistence.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the LanguageScreen widget.

methods.name: _onNext
methods.description: Handles the action when the user presses the 'NEXT' button: saves preferences and navigates to OTP validation screen.
